second_pass.method: 首轮逐段检查外层表达骨架和内部搭配，二遍回看全部未收段及已收段中的对比、让步、否定、责任和请求动作；只在总统素材内查重，未按组成词简单推定掌握。
second_pass.intentionally_omitted: 称呼名单、套式宗教祝福、专名和政治口号、一次性长比喻；单词义项不伪装固定词块。

items.note: 此处恐怖袭击，也可指观点受到批评。
items.quote: Today our fellow citizens, our way of life, our very freedom came under attack in a series of deliberate and deadly terrorist acts.

items.note: 强调多次或多个相关事件。
items.quote: Today our fellow citizens, our way of life, our very freedom came under attack in a series of deliberate and deadly terrorist acts.

items.note: 此处 disbelief、sadness、anger，非装满物品。
items.quote: The pictures of airplanes flying into buildings, fires burning, huge structures collapsing have filled us with disbelief, terrible sadness, and a quiet, unyielding anger.

items.note: 原句袭击意图，不等于实际结果。
items.quote: These acts of mass murder were intended to frighten our Nation into chaos and retreat, but they have failed.

items.meaning: 恐吓某人，使其陷入某状态／做某事
items.note: into 标示受恐吓导致的结果。
items.quote: These acts of mass murder were intended to frighten our Nation into chaos and retreat, but they have failed.

items.meaning: 阻止某物发生某种行为
items.note: 原句 light from shining 为比喻；结构不是藏住某物。
items.quote: And no one will keep that light from shining.

items.meaning: 以某人力所能及的任何方式
items.note: 原句 could 随过去时间，不固定成只能 can。
items.quote: And we responded with the best of America, with the daring of our rescueworkers, with the caring for strangers and neighbors who came to give blood and help in any way they could.

items.note: 非流血受伤。
items.quote: And we responded with the best of America, with the daring of our rescueworkers, with the caring for strangers and neighbors who came to give blood and help in any way they could.

items.note: 具体工作搭配，不收 entire 事件报道。
items.quote: Immediately following the first attack, I implemented our Government's emergency response plans.

items.chunk: Our first priority is to do sth.
items.note: 可明确事项排序，不表示别的完全不重要。
items.quote: Our first priority is to get help to those who have been injured and to take every precaution to protect our citizens at home and around the world from further attacks.

items.chunk: take every precaution to do sth.
items.meaning: 采取一切预防措施以做某事
items.note: every 强调尽力预防，不是结果保证。
items.quote: Our first priority is to get help to those who have been injured and to take every precaution to protect our citizens at home and around the world from further attacks.

items.meaning: 保护某人免受某种威胁
items.note: from 引出风险源。
items.quote: Our first priority is to get help to those who have been injured and to take every precaution to protect our citizens at home and around the world from further attacks.

items.note: 可用于服务或工作持续。
items.quote: The functions of our Government continue without interruption.

items.meaning: 照常营业／已恢复开展业务
items.note: 此处政府、经济也用作恢复运作，并非全都商店。
items.quote: Federal agencies in Washington which had to be evacuated today are reopening for essential personnel tonight and will be open for business tomorrow.

items.note: 原句 search；不只是交通行进。
items.quote: The search is underway for those who are behind these evil acts.

items.meaning: 是某事的幕后策划者／责任人
items.note: 此处不是空间在后面或支持计划义。
items.quote: The search is underway for those who are behind these evil acts.

items.note: 要求法律追责，非私人报复。
items.quote: I've directed the full resources of our intelligence and law enforcement communities to find those responsible and to bring them to justice.

items.chunk: make no distinction between A and B
items.meaning: 不区分A与B，一视同仁处理
items.note: 可能是强调同等责任，不总是积极公平。
items.quote: We will make no distinction between the terrorists who committed these acts and those who harbor them.

items.note: 原句省略事件宾语，非通常认真负责的褒义形容。
items.quote: I've directed the full resources of our intelligence and law enforcement communities to find those responsible and to bring them to justice.

items.note: 语气强烈，非轻度不同意。
items.quote: I appreciate so very much the Members of Congress who have joined me in strongly condemning these attacks.

items.note: 通常针对死亡，不用于一般工作延期。
items.quote: And on behalf of the American people, I thank the many world leaders who have called to offer their condolences and assistance.

items.meaning: 我感谢／欣赏某事或某人的帮助
items.note: 此处对国会谴责袭击表示感谢；不一定指审美欣赏。
items.quote: I appreciate so very much the Members of Congress who have joined me in strongly condemning these attacks.

items.note: 原句反恐团结，不能把政治任务当默认槽位。
items.quote: America and our friends and allies join with all those who want peace and security in the world, and we stand together to win the war against terrorism.

items.chunk: a sense of safety and security
items.note: sense 表主观感受，不是独立安全核证。
items.quote: Tonight I ask for your prayers for all those who grieve, for the children whose worlds have been shattered, for all whose sense of safety and security has been threatened.

items.note: 原句 prayers 为宗教支持，工作可用于具体帮助。
items.quote: Tonight I ask for your prayers for all those who grieve, for the children whose worlds have been shattered, for all whose sense of safety and security has been threatened.

items.meaning: 来自各行各业／社会各阶层
items.note: walk of life 非走路方式。
items.quote: This is a day when all Americans from every walk of life unite in our resolve for justice and peace.

items.chunk: unite in one's resolve to/for sth.
items.meaning: 共同坚定决心以实现某事
items.note: 原句 for justice and peace；to 后接动词。
items.quote: This is a day when all Americans from every walk of life unite in our resolve for justice and peace.

pending.note: 原句 stood down enemies 保留，可能与常见退场/解除戒备义不同，教学前核查。
pending.quote: America has stood down enemies before, and we will do so this time.
pending.status: 搭配义项待核，不作为已核标准用法教学。

quote_recovery: 已确认候选的原例收为目标所在完整原句或必要连续片段；只回收原文子串，没有发现新项或改写。原精选精确引文保留。
